_notes: Furnace-into-hell doorway. Embers_Burst (burst:true) = Unreal-baked one-shot ember_burst sheet (8x8, 30 fps, 2.13 s): rate is bursts per second, maxParticles caps overlap, intensity is the sheet HDR multiplier (sheet RGB reaches ~12); the 1x1 ember rows stay as ambient drift. Gate opening x -2..2, floor y 1.9, top y 6.9, front face z 27. Camera looks +Z from z<20. Emissive values are HDRP nits; exposure is fixed EV10 so about 1230 nits reads as display 1.0. Particle intensity values are display-referred HDR (1.0 = white) via the Furnace/Particle shader. Particle shapes use euler (-90,0,0): shapeScale = [width x, depth z, height y]. velocityMin/Max are world-space m/s (z negative = out of the doorway toward the camera). Gradients are 8-bit vertex colours (0..1); HDR comes from intensity.
